title: Canonical generator characterization of second localization
statement: For commutative rings R,A,B,Bp,D with R-algebras A,B,Bp, compatible B-algebra Bp and compatible tensor-algebra coefficient maps to D, use the BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel conventions and derived categories of modules in a common universe. Define the derived coefficient map and its D-linear generator characterization using exact extension along a flat map B to Bp. The coefficient map is the adjoint transpose of the source cohomologyIso, inverse flat derived homology isomorphism, homology of the derived lift of the ordinary scalar-extension associator, and inverse target cohomologyIso. The predicate fixes the image of 1 tensor x for every x. This determines a D-linear map uniquely.

proof.text: Construct flat homology comparison by lifting the exact ordinary homology isomorphism through derived localization. Derive the ordinary associator using leftDerivedLift and the target universal counit. Compose the source cohomology isomorphism, flat homology isomorphism, homology of the derived lift and inverse target cohomology isomorphism, and transpose by extension/restriction adjunction. Define the generator predicate by this actual coefficient map. Equality of predicates gives equality of morphisms by ExtendScalars.hom_ext.
